description: Returns the 2026 or 2027 standard deduction piece by piece: the basic amount for the filing status, the additional amount for each person 65 or older or blind, a dependent's limit, and the rule that a married person filing separately whose spouse itemizes must itemize; with anyone 65 or older it also states the senior deduction's maximum before its phase-out. The amounts are the website's standard deduction pages' own figures (2027: the IRS's published amounts, Rev. Proc. 2026-35). Not tax advice.

age.description: Your age on December 31 of the tax year (0-120): 65 or older adds the additional amount and the senior deduction.

dependent.description: Not on a joint return: someone else can claim you as a dependent (the basic amount is limited, IRC 63(c)(5)). Default false.

filing_status.description: Filing status: single, married filing jointly (mfj), married filing separately (mfs) or head of household (hoh).

spouse_age.description: Joint return only: the spouse's age. Default: the same as age.

spouse_blind.description: Joint return only: the spouse is blind. Default false.

spouse_itemizes.description: mfs only: your spouse itemizes on a separate return, so you must too.

tax_year.description: 2026 (default) or 2027. 2027: the IRS's published 2027 standard deduction, additional amounts and dependent limit (Rev. Proc. 2026-35). Stated in the result.

wages.description: Your wages (a dependent's earned income). Default 0.

name: standard_deduction_vs_itemizing
title: Standard deduction piece by piece (2026 or 2027)
